recommendation: Tail is above the 25% block threshold while technology-led downside remains aligned; reassessment hinges on whether meaningful retracements and cross-asset stabilization emerge.
headline: Technology-led downside remains persistently aligned
body: Late-morning technology losses deepened from the opening decline, semiconductor weakness remained broad, and elevated long Treasury yields and oil continued to reinforce downside pressure. The evidence supports elevated Tail, but detailed independent NQ pullback structure remains incomplete, limiting escalation beyond the low-30s.

lookbackSummary: Tail moved from low readings on August 17 into WATCH overnight and then above the block threshold during August 18 as downside technology, semiconductor, yields, volatility and oil signals became more aligned.
outlookSummary: The current block state is expected to persist conditionally through the early afternoon. Tail can decay with meaningful retracements and cross-asset stabilization, but power-hour, the futures reopen, Wednesday oil inventories and the upcoming FOMC minutes remain risk checkpoints.
